title: L5 대화-2
body_text:
B: I’m sorry, but how can I get to the Sky Cinema?
G: It’s not far, but it’s a little difficult to find. Why don’t you take a taxi?
B: OK. How long will it take?
G: By taxi? About 20 minutes.
